assessments.reasoning: The complete 1,866-byte COPYING.EXCEPTION at autotools-mirror/autoconf commit 5ec29d5a4991e1fee322a48e7358e5bcd17c645c has the claimed digest. The title, date, FSF copyright line and GPLv3 §7 declaration establish the identity within that specimen. The mirror is the capture route for the FSF text.

The pinned Index exception row at bytes [640,783) covers the expressly additional output permission. A separate document can satisfy this criterion because its own text ties the grant to a base license. Base-edition applicability to a particular file requires separate support.

limitations: The witness is the pinned Autoconf 2.71 specimen in the autotools mirror. Application to a file depends on its copyright-holder notice. That notice may offer further version choices.
“Active” is editorial. This assessment identifies the documentary form. Byte equality, formal SPDX template matching and a release-specific SPDX crosswalk fall outside these bindings.
